subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Relacionar as partes de um texto (parágrafos) para construir seu sentido global.

components.description_pt: Identificar a ideia principal de parágrafos individuais dentro de um texto em língua inglesa
components.description_en: Identify the main idea of individual paragraphs within an English-language text
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between the main topic of a full text and the focus of individual paragraphs

components.description_pt: Conectar ideias através de parágrafos para construir o significado geral de um texto
components.description_en: Connect ideas across paragraphs to construct the overall meaning of a text
components.cc_component_description: Explain how an author builds connections between ideas across sections of an informational text

components.description_pt: Usar palavras, frases e sentenças de transição para ligar ideias através de parágrafos
components.description_en: Use transitional words, phrases, and sentences to link ideas across paragraphs
components.cc_component_description: Use transitional words, phrases, and sentences to link ideas across paragraphs

cc_matches.description: Write informative/explanatory texts to examine a topic and convey ideas and information clearly.
Identify the main topic of a multiparagraph text as well as the focus of specific paragraphs within the text.

Analyze how the author unfolds an analysis or series of ideas or events, including the order in which the points are made, how they are introduced and developed, and the connections that are drawn between them.
